title: 新词雷达：key 和数据目录
title_en: New Term Radar: keys and data folder
description: 都只保存在本机（~/.workbuddy 目录下），连接时交给本机的服务器，不经过云端。下面的注册链接是作者的推荐链接，从各家官网直接拿的 key 用起来完全一样。
description_en: All stay on this machine (under ~/.workbuddy) and go to the local server when it starts, never through a cloud. The sign-up links below are the author's referral links; a key from each site directly works the same.
docLabel: key 管什么、每次花多少钱
docLabel_en: What the keys are for, and what a run costs

fields.label: AIsa API key
fields.description: X 帖子、Google Ads 搜索量、DataForSEO Trends 和判断名字的模型都走它，按次付费。注册（作者的推荐链接）：https://go.aisa.one/yansen-zhu
fields.description_en: Pays for the X posts, Google Ads volumes, DataForSEO Trends and the model that judges names, per call. Sign up (the author's referral link): https://go.aisa.one/yansen-zhu

fields.label: GoAnyAPI key（可选）
fields.description: 给每个名字加上 Google Trends 的相关查询，较大的词改用单个国家结算到昨天的日数据来读，每天约 0.07 USD。注册（作者的推荐链接）：https://goanyapi.com/r/ga-95708898fb
fields.description_en: Adds Google Trends' related queries for each name and reads the bigger rows from one country's daily series settled to yesterday, about 0.07 USD a day. Sign up (the author's referral link): https://goanyapi.com/r/ga-95708898fb

fields.label: 数据目录
fields.description: 雷达的数据库和快照放在这里：填本机一个能写的绝对路径，不存在会自动建。已经用命令行或定时任务在跑雷达的，填同一个目录，recent_leads 才看得到它们记下的线索。
fields.description_en: Where the radar keeps its database and snapshots: an absolute path on this machine it can write, created if missing. If the command line or a schedule already runs the radar, give the same folder so recent_leads sees what they kept.
